failure.message:
Expected values to be strictly equal:

7 !== 9

cause: localRpc allocates id using shared ++localReads, awaits fetch/json, then compares response id with mutable localReads. Concurrent Promise.all slotFor token calls advance localReads before earlier response, so valid id7 is compared to9.
protocolResult: No callback execution records started; cannot classify as Yearn protocol rejection.
minimalFix: Capture const id=++localReads once and use id for request and response; retain total localReads budget.
requiredRegression: Two concurrent requests return in reverse order and both remain correctly associated
retention: Keep failed callback53 and canonical build/observer/Ready artifacts unchanged; reuse valid Ready and do not repeat completed default/direct16/8. Record tooling_defect LearningCase and final codify commit.
